selection.policy: Select remaining papers and assign 1 dev / 7 test before examining retrieval outputs or tuning. Freeze sources and reviewed labels before final testing.
selection.exclude: QASPER train/validation/test paper IDs, existing HMC development paper, and duplicate arXiv versions.
selection.report: Paper titles/versions/hashes, topics, layouts, exclusions, question categories, and reviewer provenance. Do not infer generator pretraining independence.

metrics.missing_parse_evidence: Keep in denominator as zero; report missing/ambiguous mappings separately.
metrics.unanswerable: Exclude from retrieval metrics; assess refusal separately after generating and reviewing answers.
metrics.aggregation: Question macro mean plus per-paper/category results. Final comparisons use paired paper-cluster bootstrap (seed=42, resamples=2000); 2-paper pilot has no inferential CI.

generation.plan: Use one existing provider/model for all variants; record exact model, prompt hash, temperature, output limit, context budget, request failures and actual API usage. Human answer review must precede reporting answer scores.

rating.faithfulness: 0 unsupported claim / 1 partly supported / 2 all substantive claims supported
rating.abstention: For unanswerable questions: explicit absence with no invented value
rating.citations: Review claim-source support and coverage; valid citation numbers alone do not establish correctness

test_gate: No test run until 10-paper manifest, paper split, labels and configuration are frozen and test labels are independently human-verified. Current executable supports dev only.
baseline_policy: Keep existing QASPER and HMC artifacts unchanged. This pilot is a new PDF-pipeline diagnostic, not a new score on either benchmark.
